findings.location: sources.references[0].title: Teschl, Section 9.1 pp. 181–186, described as covering self-adjoint boundary conditions for first-order differential expressions.
findings.evidence: Teschl §9.1 is the Sturm–Liouville section; equation (9.1) defines the second-order expression τf = r⁻¹(−(pf′)′ + qf), and Theorem 9.6 discusses boundary conditions for that expression. It does not describe first-order momentum expressions. The assigned consumer uses a locally proved result, but the citation description is inaccurate. [Teschl, Mathematical Methods in Quantum Mechanics](https://www.mat.univie.ac.at/~gerald/ftp/book-schroe/schroe.pdf)

findings.location: sources.references[0].title: BIPM Chapter 2 pp. 15–25 and Table 2, described as supporting base and derived units and the exact defining constants h, c, e.
findings.evidence: In the linked BIPM brochure, §2.2 Table 1 lists defining constants h, c, and e; §2.3.1 Table 2 lists only SI base units; derived-unit examples are in Tables 5–6. The supplier's constant values are correct, but its source locator and description are inaccurate. [BIPM, The International System of Units, 9th ed., version 4.01](https://www.bipm.org/documents/20126/41483022/SI-Brochure-9-EN.pdf)
